summary: Synthwave (retrowave, outrun): 80-118 BPM 80s retro, a LinnDrum-style straight beat with a gated-reverb snare on 2 and 4, a resonant synth bass pulsing 8ths on the roots, detuned analog pads on a minor four-chord loop, a bright square or saw lead; knowledge/style/synthwave.json is its template
body: Tempo: 80-118 BPM for the classic groove, about 100 typical; 128-140 for faster outrun.

Drums: an 80s drum machine (LinnDrum, Roland TR-505/707, the 808's cowbell), a straight rock beat (kick on 1 and 3, snare or clap on 2 and 4, 8th hats), almost no velocity variation; the snare through a big reverb then a gate (gated reverb), a room reverb and parallel compression on the drum bus; tom fills at phrase ends.
Bass: an analog synth bass (square or saw, detuned, a resonant low-pass with a filter envelope) repeating the chord root in 8ths or 16ths, sidechained to the kick so it pumps.

Harmony: minor keys (brooding, soundtrack) over major (cheesier synth-pop): i-VI-VII, i-VI-III-VII, vi-IV-I-V; four chords looping over four bars, held on warm detuned analog pads or synth strings, brassy stabs and an arpeggio high and low in the mix.
Lead: a bright square or saw lead (or a brassy poly), monophonic, a few notes, vibrato and glide, plenty of reverb and delay; never a wash or pad as the lead.
Texture/master: wide and glossy: chorus on pads, bass and lead, gated reverb, gentle saturation, a little sidechain pump; bright but not harsh.

Sources (2026-11-26): Mode Audio 'Synthwave: 5 Production Essentials'; EDMProd 'How to Make Synthwave'; Native Instruments 'Synthwave'; MusicRadar '11 quick-fire tips for creating Stranger Things-style synthwave'.
Apply: pattern/basic-rock on the drums, then pattern/prog-synthwave-common-1 on the keys four bars later. For a whole style change the Team Lead's restyle uses knowledge/style/synthwave.json instead.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
